INSERT INTO aftersales_warehouse_location_suggest ( id, sku_id, sku_no, warehouse_id, warehouse_area_code, suggest_warehouse_location_code, sort, disabled, version, is_deleted, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.skuNo}, #{item.warehouseId}, #{item.warehouseAreaCode}, #{item.suggestWarehouseLocationCode}, #{item.sort}, #{item.disabled}, 0, false, #{item.createUserId}, #{item.createUserName}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateUserId}, #{item.updateUserName}, #{item.updateTime} )
ON CONFLICT (sku_no, warehouse_id, suggest_warehouse_location_code) WHERE is_deleted = false DO UPDATE SET sort = EXCLUDED.sort, disabled = EXCLUDED.disabled, warehouse_area_code = EXCLUDED.warehouse_area_code, version = aftersales_warehouse_location_suggest.version + 1, update_user_id = EXCLUDED.update_user_id, update_user_name = EXCLUDED.update_user_name, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time -- 这里使用传入的最新时间
